verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a Fetch capability that converts a URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, but nothing shows that API accepting a selector to wait for before returning. The "full browser control with auto-waits" claim describes session-level browser automation. That is a developer building block (you would script the waiting yourself), not an API option that waits on a specified selector, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the API wait for a specific selector to appear before returning the rendered page
